chunks: When you board a ship and it is moving, then perform salat (prayer) while seated; and if it is stationary, then perform salat (prayer) while standing.

key_terms.السَّفِينَةَ: the ship or vessel on which the person is traveling
key_terms.تَسِيرُ: is moving or proceeding through travel

ai.seo_question: How should salat (prayer) be performed on a moving or stationary ship according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for performing salat (prayer) on a ship according to its condition. If the ship is moving, one prays seated, and if it is stationary, one prays standing, reflecting the adjustment of worship to practical circumstances.
